#049 · Poison Moth Pokémon

Venomoth

Bug Poison

Kanto · Generation 1

Venomoth is a Bug/Poison-type Poison Moth Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 12.5 kg. It evolves from Venonat. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (90), with a base stat total of 450.
